image_title: Consolidated Financial Data - Third Quarter, Fiscal 2026
summary: This table presents the consolidated statement of comprehensive income for Infosys for the three months ended December 31, 2025, and December 31, 2024, along with growth percentages year-over-year (YoY) and quarter-over-quarter (QoQ). Key metrics include revenues, operating profit, and net profit, with revenues increasing by 3.2% YoY to $5,099 million, while operating profit decreased by 11.0% YoY to $937 million. The operating margin also saw a decline from 21.3% to 18.4%. Notably, the net profit after non-controlling interests was $747 million, reflecting a 7.2% decrease compared to the previous year. The table also includes a reconciliation of reported IFRS financial measures to adjusted non-IFRS financial measures, highlighting adjustments for labor codes and their impact on operating profit and net profit.
